text: 80 Things we need : • Two raw mangoes • One teaspoon salt • One tablespoon sugar • One teaspoon chilli powder • Plate or bowl • Knife • Spoon • Wash the raw mangoes thoroughly. • Cut the raw mangoes into small pieces. • Sprinkle salt and chilli powder. • Add sugar. • Mix well with a spoon. Our yummy summer salad is ready to eat. 5. Listen and do. Let’s make a summer salad. Let’s begin.
